title: Data And AI Ethics
description: Consent, license, fairness, disclosure, and who is missing.

levels.name: Foundation
levels.description: Can cite the license or terms of use, name a use they refuse, and write an AI disclosure with tool, purpose and what was independently checked — under written guidance.

levels.name: Apprentice
levels.description: Can give a concrete unfair-but-legal example on this dataset or system, name who is missing from the table, and update the ethics note when the analysis changes.

levels.name: Practitioner
levels.description: Can independently write a system card that states who should not use the system, make oversight operational — who looks, how often — and keep the recommendation weaker than or equal to the evidence.

levels.name: Journeyman
levels.description: Can diagnose a disclosure that hides the tool, a license that forbids the use, or a fairness claim with no named missing group, and produce a card another reviewer can hold the team to.

levels.name: Mastery Evidence
levels.description: Can review another apprentice's ethics note or system card, name a slogan oversight or a use the license forbids, and teach how to name who is missing on an unfamiliar dataset.
